summary: Ingress modifier truncates multi-value tenant-role header during edge upgrade, resulting in missing role bindings and 403s
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reported a sudden increase in 403s for API requests that require tenant-scoped role bindings after we rolled an edge/ingress modifier update in their private VPC. The requests include an 'x-tenant-roles' header which contains multiple comma-separated role values. After the upgrade, the serving runtime shows the request as authenticated but with no roles attached, leading to authorization rejections.

Impact:
- Multiple Novum Health users across teams are blocked from calling admin-scoped endpoints.
- Affects production traffic in us-east for this private deployment.
- Potentially broad: the customer uses multi-value headers to represent role sets, which is common in our private RBAC integrations.

Environment:
- Private deployment (customer-managed ingress) behind Redwood identity proxy
- Cluster: prod-us-east
- Agent/edge version rolled: ingress-modifier v3.7.1 -> v3.8.0 (rolled on 2026-03-09 22:10 UTC)
- Auth components: identity-proxy v2.4.3, rbac-service v1.12.0
steps_to_reproduce:
1) On a private deployment using multi-value role headers (x-tenant-roles: role-a,role-b,role-c) send a request to an admin API route with a valid access token.
2) Confirm request succeeds pre-upgrade (roles observed in request context).
3) Deploy ingress-modifier v3.8.0 which includes header normalization changes.
4) Re-send request and observe response: 403 and rbac logs show an empty role list for the request.
logs:
Relevant snippets from rbact-service and ingress logs: 
- rbac-service: INFO authorization denied user=svc:novum-user tenant=novum-prod roles=[] resource=/v1/admin/config decision=deny
- ingress-modifier: DEBUG incoming-header x-tenant-roles='role-a, role-b, role-c' normalized-header x-tenant-roles='role-a'
- identity-proxy: INFO token validated subject=svc:novum-user
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: header normalization logic in ingress-modifier is folding multi-value headers and keeping only the first token when header length or internal list normalization triggers.
What we checked so far:
- Replayed a production request via a test proxy and observed header mutation at the edge during normalization stage. The original header arriving at ingress was 'role-a, role-b, role-c' but downstream the header value seen by the auth service was 'role-a'.
- Verified identity-proxy and rbac-service logs show authentication succeeded; role parsing happened downstream and shows truncated value.
- Compared old and new ingress-modifier code paths: v3.8.0 introduced a header-sanitizer that splits on commas but then applies an aggressive dedupe and trimming routine which accidentally drops values containing internal whitespace when running under the 'single-valued' compatibility flag.
- Reproduced in staging by toggling the compatibility flag and observing roles restored when flag is disabled.
- Determined this only impacts multi-value headers that have spaces after commas (common from some IDPs) and when the proxy is configured to coalesce headers into a single header entry.
comments: 2026-03-10 15:40 - Support (Aisha Kapoor): Customer called in reporting regressions for admin API. Attached example requests and response traces. Escalating due to P1 impact.
2026-03-10 16:10 - SRE (Diego Martinez): Captured ingress-modifier version and started a staged repro in our sandbox. Observed header value mutated between edge and auth-service.

2026-03-10 18:25 - Engineering (Li Chen): Confirmed code change in v3.8.0 header sanitizer; added unit test that fails for 'role-a, role-b'. Preparing hotfix branch. Linked PR https://github.com/redwood/ingress-proxy/pull/412
2026-03-11 09:02 - Customer (Novum Health, Emma Ross): Noted outage window for admin workflows yesterday evening. Provided sample traces and timestamped pcap. Asked for ETA on fix.
2026-03-11 12:30 - Support (Aisha Kapoor): Notified customer we have a confirmed root cause and a proposed mitigation (rollback or toggle compatibility flag). Providing temporary mitigation steps.

2026-03-12 02:14 - Engineering (Diego Martinez): Deployed hotfix (ingress-modifier v3.8.1) to canary; hotfix preserves whitespace-trimmed values and properly emits multi-value header entries. Running canary tests now.
resolution:
Mitigation implemented: Engineering released ingress-modifier v3.8.1 which adjusts the header-sanitizer to: 1) split on commas, 2) trim whitespace from each token, 3) preserve all tokens when configured to coalesce headers, and 4) add a feature-flag to enable strict single-value compatibility only when explicitly requested.
Rollout notes:
- Hotfix rolled to customer's us-east private ingress at 2026-03-12 02:40 UTC.
- Post-deploy tests: sample requests from Novum Health now show roles=['role-a','role-b','role-c'] at rbac-service and admin endpoints return 200.
Follow-up actions:
- Engineering to add e2e test in ingress-proxy suite for multi-value role headers with several common IDP whitespace patterns.
- Support to coordinate with Novum Health to monitor for 72 hours, confirm no more 403 regressions.
- Create a KB article documenting the header compatibility flag and recommended IDP normalization practices.
